idea: A wall-resolved LES of the Hudson/Cherukat smooth wavy wall at lambda = 2 delta, run with the deposited rib-WRLES numerics and validated against two public reference data sets, gives a second high-fidelity two-dimensional repeating geometry on which the a-priori ODE wall-model diagnostic is evaluated.

hudson_dns_reference_l2.note: Maass-Schumann DNS vs Hudson LDV on the identical rel-L2 metric

ode_verdict.statement: On the mild wavy wall (2a/lambda=0.10, lambda=2delta, Re_h=3460) the pressure-gradient ODE wall model is NOT a failure instance at the finest grid: R2(tau_w) = {'0.05': 0.864, '0.1': 0.597, '0.2': 0.119, '0.3': -0.433} across eta_m/delta = [0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3], with epsilon_median = {'0.05': 0.44, '0.1': 0.219, '0.2': 0.11, '0.3': 0.074}. The verdict is invariant across the 3-grid ladder.

fidelity: OpenFOAM-10 pimpleFoam wall-resolved LES (WALE), NOT DNS; numerics = deposited rib_les_dtype
